rule.name: FutureWithoutException
rule.message: Complete the future on the failure path too: call future.completeExceptionally(error) from the listener's error callback, or catch the failure in the callback and pass it on, or use an API that returns a CompletableFuture itself, such as CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(task, executor) or HttpClient.sendAsync. This future is completed only with complete(...) from a callback, so when the work behind the callback fails it never completes and whoever waits on it waits forever.
